# generated by scripts/sync-agents.mjs from .agents/.commands/img.md — edit that file, then run `make agents_sync`.
description: Create, approve or improve an image with the Cobra agent and the ai-image-generation skill, inside the repo's design system
argument-hint: <brief, or a verb: recall | new-series | add-slot | generate | approve | check | improve | document, plus arguments>
---

## User Input

```text
$ARGUMENTS
```

1. Resolve the input, first match wins; state it in one line so the user can correct it:
   - the first word is a Cobra verb (`recall`, `new-series`, `add-slot`, `generate`, `approve`, `check`, `improve`, `document`) → that verb, the rest of the text as its arguments;
   - any other text → a brief: run `generate` for the series and slot it fits in `.physarum/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/index.json`; no series fits → `new-series` first; several slots fit → name them in the line and ask which; the slot already has generations → say the run adds a new ledger entry;
   - empty → list the series and slots from `index.json` and ask what to make.
2. Check the target. `.physarum/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/AGENTS.md` missing → STOP: say Cobra is not set up in this repo, and that a one-off image outside Cobra is the `ai-image-generation` skill invoked directly. Do not create the Cobra folder from this command.
3. Invoke `ai-image-generation` with the resolved input. Its Cobra-first rule hands control to `cobra-agent/AGENTS.md`, which owns the procedure, the style lock, the agreement before `belt app run`, and where the draft image and ledger entry go. `improve` and `document` follow the skill's `references/document.md`.
4. STOP at the first of these Cobra reaches: the check result and superprompt path; the estimate with the question awaiting the owner's agreement; the saved draft path with its ledger entry; the final path with its `approved` ledger entry; the proposed diff awaiting the owner's agreement. Suggest `/img approve <gen-id>` after a generation, or `/img improve` after the owner's review notes; no other command follows. Do not run `belt app run` before the owner agrees; a copy outside `.physarum/ai-image-generate/` comes only from an approved `final/` image, when the owner asks and after Cobra asks first.
